title: First Edition: Museum of Modern Egyptian Art
intro: FRAME’s first edition worked with young people inside the Museum of Modern Egyptian Art in Cairo to explore, co-design and test new ways of engaging with art.
museum_text: To add: a short history of the museum and its collection, and how the collaboration came about.
method_text: To add: who took part and how they were selected, the workshops and formats used in each phase, and how decisions were made together.
support_text: The First Edition is supported by UNESCO x Seventeen – Going Together: Youth Creativity and Well-Being.
